title: CBSE Class 9 - English Grammar
subtitle: Modals
description: Online practice test containing 50 high-yield objective MCQs for Class 9 Modals.

questions.q: Which modal verb expresses strong obligation or legal compulsion?
Fill in the blank: 'You _____ follow the traffic rules.'
Fill in the blank: '_____ I come in, Sir?'
Which modal is used to express ability in the present?
Fill in the blank: 'She _____ speak three languages fluently when she was ten.'
Fill in the blank: 'You _____ consult a doctor immediately.'
Which modal verb expresses moral duty or social obligation?
Fill in the blank: 'We _____ respect our elders.'
Fill in the blank: 'It _____ rain tonight; look at the dark clouds.'
Which modal is used to make a polite request?
Fill in the blank: '_____ you mind opening the window, please?'
Fill in the blank: 'Candidates _____ answer all questions.'
Which modal expresses absence of obligation or necessity?
Fill in the blank: 'You _____ buy a ticket; entrance is free.'
Which modal expresses Prohibition?
Fill in the blank: 'You _____ park your car in front of the gate.'
Fill in the blank: '_____ you live long and prosper!'
Fill in the blank: 'He worked hard so that he _____ pass the exam.'
Which modal is used to express past habit?
Fill in the blank: 'When I was young, I _____ swim across this river.'
Fill in the blank: 'How _____ you disobey your teacher!'
Fill in the blank: 'Walk carefully lest you _____ fall.'
Which modal verb is used to offer assistance politely?
Fill in the blank: '_____ I help you with those heavy bags?'
Fill in the blank: 'There _____ be a mistake in this invoice.'
